properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 28 at 2:47PM PDT until October 29 at 4:00PM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...High astronomical tides will cause minor flooding in low
lying areas around Humboldt Bay. Up to one half foot of
saltwater inundation above ground level is possible near
shorelines and tidal waterways. Between 9.0 and 9.3 feet MLLW
at the North Spit tide gauge is predicted.

* WHERE...Northern Coastal Humboldt County.

* WHEN...From 1 PM to 4 PM PDT Thursday. High tide is at 1:59 PM
at the Humboldt Bay North Spit tide gauge. Saltwater inundation
will be possible 1 to 2 hours before and after high tide.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of low lying areas around Humboldt Bay
including parks and roads with only isolated closures expected.
Flooding will likely impact Jackson Ranch Road in the Arcata
Bottoms and several roads in King Salmon.
properties.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory indicates that onshore winds and tides
will combine to generate flooding of low areas along the shore.

Feet Above Ground is locally defined as feet above the Highest
Astronomical Tide or HAT.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 1 PM TO 4 PM PDT THURSDAY

properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 28 at 11:46AM PDT until October 30 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal
flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 1 PM PDT Thursday.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 1 PM Thursday to 2 PM PDT
Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents and managers of
infrastructure in the warned/advisory area should prepare for
rising water and take appropriate action to protect life and
property. Highest tides will occur around 11 AM on Thursday and
noon on Friday. Observed high tides are 1.4 to 1.6 feet above
astronomical tide predictions.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

properties.areaDesc: Northwestern Interior Mendocino; Northeastern Interior Mendocino; Northern Lake
properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 28 at 10:53AM PDT until October 29 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 28 expected.

* WHERE...Northern Mendocino Interior, and Northern Lake.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Del Norte; Interior Del Norte; Northern Coastal Humboldt; Southwestern Humboldt; Northeastern Interior Humboldt; Southeastern Interior Humboldt; Coastal Mendocino; Southwestern Interior Mendocino
properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 28 at 10:53AM PDT until October 29 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Del Norte, Humboldt, and Mendocino Coast, Humboldt
Interior, Interior Del Norte, and Southwestern Interior Mendocino.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some valleys, especially closer to the coast,
may experience low cloud cover and/or fog, which will limit the
potential for frost.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
